scope: Independent source-literal SYNTHETIC paired checkpoint oracle, not PS2 card format or native evidence

card.after_load_restore_advance: Card remains byte-identical to card-saved.bin; these operations alter RAM only

full_normalized_report.limits: Qualified saved observations only; narrative normalization does not prove controls/layout, code facts do not prove ABI, and exact RGBA does not approve artwork. Coverage requires the source progress tuple to change before resumed, not live runtime authenticity.

normalization.bundle_sha256: Verify actual bundle SHA then replace with NORMALIZED_BUNDLE_SHA256
normalization.receipt_sha256: Verify each actual serialized receipt SHA and linkage before replacing with NORMALIZED_RECEIPT_SHA256
normalization.event_time: Validate actual source timestamp/order before replacing with NORMALIZED_TIME
normalization.event_offset: Validate actual strict byte offsets/log slice hashes before replacing each offset with zero
normalization.pid_start: WARM_PID/WARM_START for epoch0; distinct COLD_PID/COLD_START for epoch1, actual observed values must satisfy admission first
normalization.invariant: No other field removal or normalization; source_schema/epoch/cohort/states/fields/full fingerprints/phase/method/event order/capture IDs remain exact

preserved_refusals.legacy_empty_members: Still refused; exception requires BOTH explicit known Go source schema and checkpoint-only cohort
preserved_refusals.save_only: UNKNOWN until warm+cold+handoff+changed advancement+resumed and all seven captures qualify
preserved_refusals.warm: Same PID/start/epoch, actual completed warm owner
preserved_refusals.cold: Changed PID AND starttime, epoch1, actual completed cold owner
preserved_refusals.unsafe: Unlinked/missing capture, absent changed progress, partial or altered reload state cannot establish PASS
